date-picker.$description: v0.7 — DatePicker. The trigger is a read-only field-shell with a leading calendar glyph; the calendar lives in a portaled popover. This file declares the calendar grid, day-cell states, and the open/close animation. v0.7 ships the visual contract and a static calendar scaffold; consumers should compose `react-day-picker` (recommended) for real selection logic.

trigger.$description: Read-only field-shell with leading calendar icon; click opens the calendar popover.

calendar.$description: Calendar popover surface. Same recipe as Select/Combobox listbox: surface.popover + popover shadow.

width.$description: 256 px — fits 7 columns × 32 px cells with breathing room.

weekday.$description: Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su row above the day grid.

day.$description: Single day cell. Square; mono numeral; selected state is filled lime.

today.$description: Today is marked by border, not fill — so it doesn't compete with selection.

selected.$description: Near-black-green ink on lime fill — AA contrast.

today.$description: 1 px border marks today without competing with selection fill.

transition.$description: Open/close motion for the calendar popover. Honor prefers-reduced-motion: collapse to instant.
